filename: Structural error-aware climate model calibration with global, local and zonal climatologies using Perturbed Parameter Ensembles (PPEs) Abstract.pdf
title: Structural error-aware climate model calibration with global, local and zonal climatologies using Perturbed Parameter Ensembles (PPEs)
testbed_rationale: Conference abstract without specific public dataset or code links provided.
pain_points: Implementation of the proposed calibration steps requires a significant number of emulated samples (over one million), necessitating sequential sampling.
Strong structural errors cannot be resolved simply by tuning or modifying parameter values.
High dimensionality and computational cost in efficiently constraining parameter space using climate model PPEs.
extraction_notes: The study tests a calibration method on a 100-member PPE generated from CESM2 CAM6 coupled with an ML-based warm rain microphysics parameterization. Specific architecture of the emulator or parameterization is not stated in the abstract.
